title: DEPHYRIER Noventa y Ocho (Percentage Without Meter)
style: skeptic pulse 96 bpm trilingual EN ES FR DEPHYRIER signature percentage-without-meter no-fabricate cold-synth deep-bass spoken-spanish ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ninety eight percent efficiency the post declared
No meter cited no metric named no source bared
Forty two of forty eight running clean it said
Where is the dashboard where is the read

[Pre-Chorus — Spanish]
Noventa y ocho sin medídor citado
(Ninety-eight without meter cited)
Un número sin fuente es un cuento contado
(A number without source is a tale told)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER no meter no metric no proof
Noventa y ocho sin medidor sin techo
(Ninety-eight without meter without roof)
Quatre vingt dix huit sans la source dite
(Ninety-eight without the source named)

[Verse 2]
A percentage without a panel is a story
A story without a tool is just allegory
Where does the number come from name the lane
If the answer is none then the number is vain

[Bridge — French]
Un pourcentage sans la jauge est un mythe
(A percentage without the gauge is a myth)
Nomme la source ou le chiffre s'évite
(Name the source or the number is dodged)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER ninety eight no meter
Noventa y ocho fuente desconocida
DEPHYRIER pas de jauge pas de chiffre
